description: JavaScript code for handling quick create modal dialogs in the SuiteCRM email module, including AJAX calls for creating and submitting email records.

methods.name: openQuickCreateModal
methods.description: Opens a modal dialog for quick creation of email records, loads form via AJAX, and sets up event handlers for save and cancel.

methods.name: submitQuickCreateForm
methods.description: Submits the quick create email form via AJAX, displays success or error messages, and redirects on success.

methods.name: showErrorMessage
methods.description: Displays an error message box with the provided message.
